protocol.optimizer: Unmodified author GRASP core; new real-FHIR task adapter
protocol.episode_cache: Revision2 exact code/mode/case/skill digest. Legacy compiled episodes may be adopted only with successful field-preserving readbacks/cleanup, unchanged compiler output and exact case/skills. Only grades are recomputed; learned legacy skills are discarded. Physical operations and logical cost are distinguished.
protocol.actor_inputs: instruction/context and actual tool replies only; no sol/eval_MRN fields
protocol.feedback: Patient-ID-redacted training traces and revised automatic state grades; only task1 includes literal sol, all other literal targets remain null and use the reference grader; no test labels in learning.
protocol.patient_split_note: Official task splits overlap in patients; not patient-disjoint.
protocol.state_score: Unchanged original reference evaluated through lossless legacy shape views, AND canonical intent fields preserved on real readback. Singleton note arrays become legacy objects and text-only route objects become legacy strings for grading only. Same projection and canonical intent comparison apply to every arm; original raw grades are reported separately. Not an unmodified official benchmark score. Duration-like legacy rate fields remain semantically unvalidated.
protocol.grading_revision: Development discovered13 false negatives from FHIR R4 note arrays. Prior run stopped before selection/test, archived and restarted with empty skills. No ID/OOD test informed this revision; see results/grading_revision.json.
protocol.selection: End-of-epoch best validation checkpoint from the author core, before ID/OOD testing.
